title: Run Kev: architect-interior-designer (4 cells, 6995 requests)
description:
**Self-contained run.** Give this issue ID to an agent on any Mac; it does the whole job by following the runbook in **BD-dd780c** (`kbs show BD-dd780c`). This repository uses Git Flow: work from `develop`, never push to `main`.

**Job:** answer the registered 500-item subsample of the still-missing Kev cells for `architect-interior-designer`: 4 cells, exactly 6995 requests (manifest `docs/kev-runs/architect-interior-designer.json` on `develop`), roughly 11 minutes on a quiet Mac.

**Steps** (details and exact commands in the runbook)
1. `git checkout develop && git pull`. One-time setup if this Mac has not done a run.
2. Start the pinned Kev server, run `run_kev_study collect --manifest docs/kev-runs/architect-interior-designer.json` with the runbook's identity flags. It resumes if interrupted.
3. Commit only the finished files under `answers/kev/architect-interior-designer/` (never `.partial.jsonl`) to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push that branch. No `bd replay`.
4. Back on `develop`: comment the request count and any errors here, close it, `kbs commit`, push `develop`.

**Rules:** one heavy job at a time on the machine; stop the Kev server when done; never touch `project/` directly.
